answer_result.answer: Dave regularly visits parks to relax and de-stress: he finds being surrounded by nature peaceful and calming, and weekend walks "recharge" him for the entire upcoming week. He also arranged regular walks with friends at a favorite park spot and finds the peace by the river nice.

question.question: Why does Dave regularly visit parks?

evidence_items.section: # Calvin > ## Boston trip (planned as of 2023-04-20; Frank Ocean tour stop as of 2023-05-31; personal visit July 2023)
evidence_items.text:
- Not yet seen Boston apart from gigs — he has been busy with rehearsals and traveling [S3T14][S3T15].
- Looking forward to exploring the city, trying out delicious food, and visiting popular attractions [S3T15].
- Dave (apparently Boston-based) is offering to show him around — including Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park — and to take him to his favorite food spots; Calvin proposed grabbing a bite together when he is in Boston, and Dave agreed [S3T10][S3T15][S3T16] (see /memories/dave.md > ## Boston).
- Calvin is looking forward to trying the food in Boston with Dave and called it fun ("Can't wait to try out the food there with you") [S3T17].
- As of 2023-05-31, the Boston visit is part of the Frank Ocean tour: "Cool, can't wait for the tour with Frank!" — he's "buzzing to perform in Boston and see what it's like" and "Gonna be great playing for folks from home" (calling Boston's folks "from home" suggests it is where he's from, though not stated outright). He asked Dave what he thinks of the music scene there; Dave: it's "awesome — Tons of talented musicians and cool places to play," and he'll be there to cheer Calvin on (details in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston) [S7T15][S7T16].
- On 2023-06-09, said he has never been to Boston before but has heard the parks are amazing — "can't wait to visit next month" (i.e., July 2023); he wants to take walks in the Boston parks to experience their serenity and recharge, and asked Dave what cool things he remembers about them; shared a photo of a tree with pink flowers (likely from the album session); Dave's recollections of the Boston parks are in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston [S8T5][S8T7].
- As of 2023-08-22, said his tour ends soon and he's heading to Boston, and proposed meeting up with Dave then — "Maybe we can meet up then!" (renewing the earlier plan to meet in Boston, see above); Dave: "Fill me in on the details when you have them and let's meet up when you're here. Can't wait to hear all about everything!" (Note: the 2023-08-14 update described the Frank Ocean tour as already having ended with the Tokyo show, so this "tour ends soon" may be a continuation or a new tour — unconfirmed) [S15T10][S15T11].
- On 2023-09-02, told Dave he booked a flight to Boston "last week" (~2023-08-26 through 09-01) and is "so excited" about the upcoming Boston trip, sharing a photo of a book with a boarding pass on it — "See you soon, buddy!"; he'll let Dave know when he's in Boston, and Dave told him to let him know when he's free so they can catch up in Boston (continuing the plan to meet up in Boston, see above) [S17T6][S17T7][S17T8]. The chat closed with Dave: "Looking forward to seeing you! Have a safe trip, see ya!"; Calvin thanked Dave, reciprocated the safe-trip wishes ("Gotta stay safe on the trip"), said "Can't wait to see you there!", and promised he will contact Dave when he arrives [S17T9][S17T10].

Calvin: Hey Dave! Met with the creative team for my album yesterday. It was a long session, but awesome to see everything coming together. 
[S8T1] (dia_id: D8:1)

Dave: Hey Cal! Sounds great that your album's coming along. Are you feeling good about it? Here's a pic I just took.
[Image caption: a photography of a pond with a boat in it surrounded by trees]
[S8T2] (dia_id: D8:2)

Calvin: Dave, thanks for checking in. I'm feeling stoked about this album! We've been making some magic with a team in the studio, working on the music and everything. Look at what a wonderful studio we have! How have you been? Anything new since we talked?
[Image caption: a photo of a recording studio with a large window and a desk]
[S8T3] (dia_id: D8:3)

Dave: Hey, nice photo of the studio! Working in a team yields incredible results, well done! Keep pushing it! I've been doing good - thanks for asking. I've been exploring some parks on the weekends to relax - it's so peaceful being surrounded by nature. Are there any chill spots you enjoy in Boston?
[S8T4] (dia_id: D8:4)

Calvin: Thanks! That studio is great for creativity. I've never been to Boston before, but I hear the parks are amazing. Can't wait to visit next month. Anything cool you remember about Boston parks?
[Image caption: a photo of a tree with pink flowers in the foreground]
[S8T5] (dia_id: D8:5)

Dave: That sounds great! The Boston parks are awesome, especially in spring. It's so serene when you're walking around. I went for a stroll last Friday and it was amazing. It's so magical - I bet you'll love it! I love taking walks on the weekends, they recharge me for the entire upcoming week!
[S8T6] (dia_id: D8:6)

Calvin: I'm excited to experience that serenity. I can't wait to take a walk in the parks and recharge. Hey, have you been on any hikes lately?
[Image caption: a photo of a path going up a hill with a view of the mountains]
[S8T7] (dia_id: D8:7)

Dave: Nah, haven't gone hiking recently, but it's awesome - being in nature and pushing yourself to new heights. Clears your mind and brings a sense of calm. Have you been to the mountains before? Heard they're super chill.
[S8T8] (dia_id: D8:8)

Calvin: Nah, haven't been to the mountains but I'm keen to go. Looking for a way to escape it all and de-stress. I want to go on a hike to a place similar to this. What's new and exciting happening for you, Dave?
[Image caption: a photo of a plane flying over a mountain range with snow on the top]
[S8T9] (dia_id: D8:9)

Dave: I booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month! Finally gonna be able to see those majestic peaks! Gonna be an amazing experience!
[S8T10] (dia_id: D8:10)

- On 2023-05-31, reconnected with Dave ("been ages since we chatted") and told him the Frank Ocean tour the week before was "wild", including the "unreal" Tokyo show (details in ## Tokyo trip); Dave congratulated him [S7T1][S7T2]. Calvin thought Dave's car photo was of the car Dave had been fixing the engine of for a friend (Dave's neighbor; details in /memories/dave.md, section "Car maintenance shop"). The two also talked about how working on cars is relaxing: for Calvin it "chill[s]" him, "clears [his] head", "calms [him] down", and gives a real sense of achievement — "like meditating" — and Dave said the same applies to him (details in /memories/dave.md, section "Hobbies and sense of purpose") [S7T3][S7T4][S7T5][S7T6].
- The 2023-05-31 conversation continued: Calvin echoed Dave's "feeling of power and happiness" from the transformation talk — "It's great to see what we created with all our hard work and ideas" [S7T9]. Dave asked whether he always enjoys performing live (see ## Music), then what's next for his music; Calvin named the Boston stop on the Frank Ocean tour — "Gonna be great playing for folks from home" (see the Boston trip section above) [S7T10][S7T11][S7T14][S7T15]. Dave said he'll be at the Boston show to cheer him on [S7T16]. The 2023-05-31 conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave — his support "means a lot to [him]" — and saying he can't wait to experience the Boston music scene; Dave wished him a great time in Boston and said he can't wait to hear all about it when he gets back, and Calvin promised to fill him in on all the details, signing off "See you soon!" [S7T17][S7T18][S7T19].
- On 2023-06-09, caught up with Dave: told him about the creative-team album session (details in ## Music) and that he's "stoked" about the album; Dave shared a photo of a pond with a boat in it surrounded by trees, and Calvin shared a photo of the studio (details in ## Music) and one of a tree with pink flowers (details in ## Boston trip) [S8T1][S8T2][S8T3][S8T5]. They talked about nature: Dave has been exploring parks on weekends to relax; Calvin, having never been to Boston, is "can't wait" to visit in July 2023 and asked about the Boston parks (details in ## Boston trip); when Calvin asked if Dave has been on any hikes recently, Dave said no but thinks hiking is awesome — "being in nature and pushing yourself to new heights"; details on Dave's park habit and his Boston-parks stroll are in /memories/dave.md > ## Parks [S8T4][S8T5][S8T6][S8T7][S8T8]. Then Dave announced he had booked a trip to a mountainous region for next month (July 2023), and Calvin said he wants to go on a hike in the mountains to de-stress himself (details in ## Mountains and hiking); the two wished each other well for the trip and signed off "see you soon" (details in /memories/dave.md > ## Mountain trip (July 2023)) [S8T9][S8T10][S8T11][S8T12][S8T13][S8T14].
- On 2023-06-21, told Dave about the car accident and repair process (details in ## Car accident (2023-06-16)); Dave expressed sympathy that no one was hurt, asked about issues with the insurance process and how long it took, and asked about the mechanic in the garage photo [S9T2][S9T4][S9T6][S9T8].
- The 2023-06-21 conversation continued: Calvin answered Dave's skiing question — never tried it, but it looks like "a lot of fun" and he might try it once (details in ## Mountains and hiking) [S9T17]. Dave then announced that he recently joined a rock band and has been practicing guitar, sharing a photo of the band; Calvin said it's awesome and will bring him a lot of emotions, and Dave said good company and great music lift the mood and bring positive emotions (details in the Rock band section of /memories/dave.md). The conversation closed with Dave saying he had to go and "I'll see you soon!", and Calvin thanking Dave and saying "let's keep in touch, take care!" [S9T18][S9T19][S9T20][S9T21].

Dave: Hey Calvin, how's the car doing after the crash? You were stoked to get back on the road, right?
[S10T1] (dia_id: D10:1)

Calvin: Hey Dave! Thanks for checking in. It's all good now, the car's fixed and going strong. Nothing better than cruising around - it's the best! Look at how my car looks right now. How've you been? Anything new?
[Image caption: a photography of a red sports car parked on the side of the road]
[S10T2] (dia_id: D10:2)

Dave: Glad to hear your car's fixed and going strong! I've been good too. Just been hanging out with friends at parks lately. I arranged with friends for regular walks together in the park.
[S10T3] (dia_id: D10:3)

Calvin: 
That sounds like a great plan! Regular walks with friends can be a wonderful way to spend time together and stay active. Fresh air and buddies can do wonders. Do you have a favorite spot for hanging out?

Dave: Yeah, today we are going to that spot. Look at that lovely photo.
[Image caption: a photo of a city skyline with a river and boats in the water]

Calvin: Wow, what a view! That sunset over the river is gorgeous. It must be so tranquil there. Reminds me of living in my Japanese mansion with the epic cityscape. It's like a dream come true! Look at this photo I took from my backyard of the mansion. It's so beautiful!
[Image caption: a photo of a boat is docked in a canal at sunset]
[S10T6] (dia_id: D10:6)

Dave: Yeah, the peace by the river is really nice. But living in a Japanese mansion surrounded by that city skyline must be stunning. The views must be amazing!
[S10T7] (dia_id: D10:7)

Calvin: Ah, it really is beautiful. Whenever I look out the windows and see the city lights, it's so awe-inspiring. Luxury and beauty on a whole new level. Look at the front part of the mansion.
[Image caption: a photo of a large house with a lot of windows and lights]
[S10T8] (dia_id: D10:8)

- On 2023-04-20, caught up with Calvin ("long time no see"), who reported back from a Tokyo music festival; Dave reacted enthusiastically and asked what Calvin learned and where he sees his music taking him [S3T1][S3T2][S3T4][S3T6][S3T8].
- On 2023-05-31, caught up with Calvin ("been ages since we chatted"); congratulated Calvin on the Frank Ocean tour (Tokyo stop; details in /memories/calvin.md) [S7T1][S7T2]. The exchange ended with the two agreeing that transforming something and giving it a new life makes them feel like they "really achieved something" [S7T7][S7T8]. The 2023-05-31 conversation continued: Calvin echoed the "feeling of power and happiness" ("It's great to see what we created with all our hard work and ideas") [S7T9]; Dave asked whether Calvin always enjoys performing live (Calvin: it "always fuels my soul" — an "absolute high") [S7T10][S7T11], and Dave marveled at the artist-audience connection and the concert crowd photos Calvin shared (a large crowd taking pictures; a crowd watching a concert with bright lights; a band on stage), calling the atmosphere "off the charts" and saying music "brings people together ... like therapy for us all" [S7T12][S7T13][S7T14]; when Dave asked what's next for Calvin's music, Calvin named the Boston stop on the Frank Ocean tour, and Dave said he'll be there to cheer him on (details in ## Boston) [S7T14][S7T15][S7T16]. The conversation closed with Calvin thanking Dave for his support and saying he can't wait to experience the Boston music scene; Dave wished Calvin a great time in Boston and said he can't wait to hear all about it when he gets back, and Calvin promised to fill him in on all the details, signing off "See you soon!" [S7T17][S7T18][S7T19].
- On 2023-04-20, continued the catch-up: offered to show Calvin around Boston (Paradise Rock, House of Blues, Fenway Park), said he'll be in the front row when Calvin performs, and agreed to grab food at his favorite spots when Calvin visits (details in ## Boston) [S3T10][S3T15][S3T16]. Calvin shared a photo of his red sports car on display at a show, and Dave praised the work put into it [S3T13][S3T14].
- On 2023-05-01, caught up with Calvin ("long time no see") and announced that he had finally opened his own car maintenance shop — a dream come true and a step toward his other dream of working on classic cars; shared a photo of the shop (including a group of people in front of a car) and of the engine of the classic car he restored in 2022, and invited Calvin to come by; Calvin congratulated him, the conversation closed with mutual encouragement, and Calvin shared a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant (details in ## Car maintenance shop, ## Classic cars, and /memories/calvin.md) [S4T1][S4T5][S4T7][S4T15][S4T16][S4T17][S4T22][S4T23][S4T24].
- On 2023-05-01, complimented Calvin's necklace and asked where he got it (Calvin: a gift from another artist, a reminder of why he keeps hustling as a musician); encouraged Calvin to keep pushing and making music, and the two agreed to keep each other motivated — "the road can be hard, but when we remember why we're doing it, it keeps us going" (in Calvin's words) [S4T25][S4T26][S4T27][S4T28].

Dave: Thanks Calvin! Appreciate the support. I'm gonna keep learning more about auto engineering, maybe even build a custom car from scratch someday - that's the dream! For now, just gonna keep working on this project and assisting customers.

Calvin: Wow, Dave! You're so inspiring - good for you for pushing yourself to achieve your dream. Making a custom car sounds awesome. Don't forget to relax and enjoy the process too!
[S5T6] (dia_id: D5:6)

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Gotta take time to chill. Do you have any hobbies that help you relax?
[S5T7] (dia_id: D5:7)

Calvin: Hey Dave, long drives in [this car] really help me relax. The feeling of the wind and the open road is so freeing. It helps me clear my head. What do you like to do to chill out? 
[Image caption: a photo of a red sports car driving down a road]
[S5T8] (dia_id: D5:8)

Dave: Yeah, I hear you! Driving with the wind in your hair is so calming. Taking a walk around is a great way to destress, too. Exploring, taking in the sights and sounds - it's such a peaceful experience.
[S5T9] (dia_id: D5:9)

Calvin: Yea, I totally hear ya. Embracing nature has been really calming for me too. I've been loving getting to know Japanese culture. On the other hand, I'm stuck with my music at the moment, like my creativity's frozen or something. Any tips?
[S5T10] (dia_id: D5:10)

Dave: If I'm having trouble coming up with ideas, I usually immerse myself in something I love, like concerts or my favorite albums. Doing that usually helps to jumpstart my inspiration. Maybe try taking a break from music and explore other things. Plus, have some fun while you're at it!
[S5T11] (dia_id: D5:11)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Taking a break is great for getting my mojo back. I'll definitely take your advice and explore. Appreciate the help! You're awesome!
[S5T12] (dia_id: D5:12)

Dave: No worries, Calvin! Glad I could help. Keep pursuing your music and never give up. You're awesome! 🤘
[S5T13] (dia_id: D5:13)

Calvin: Thanks, appreciate it. Won't give up. Let's stay in touch! Bye!
